SASBDB entry SASDDF7  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDDF7/)

Publication: Small but large enough: structural properties of armless mitochondrial tRNAs from the nematode Romanomermis culicivorax.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gky593

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDDF7/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
